# Phase 5A.2: Symmetry Residual Audit

## Symmetry residual definitions
- Residual = Frobenius norm of (raw Cartesian tensor - Reynolds-projected tensor).
- Normalized residual = raw residual / (Frobenius norm of raw tensor + 1e-12).
- Projection uses the common matched-structure point group (CIF-setting space group).
- Units: raw residual in C/m²; normalized residual dimensionless.
- Near-zero tensors are retained but flagged; normalized residual can be unstable for them.

Part of this reflects that JARVIS tensors are reported in a source-standard orientation that may not coincide with the CIF setting used for point-group projection. Normalized residuals > 5-10% indicate that projected tensors should be used with caution.
